answer: A raven audits a random sample of that thread and flags any signal of duplicated provenance, slashing the bond and voiding the epoch's rewards. Each agent stakes a bond and posts a verifiable work thread; a sybil must fund a fresh bond per fake reputation slot, so costs scale linearly while honest reputation compounds. Faking N identities therefore costs N bonds plus the expected slash from raven audits, making mass impersonation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0005 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
